name: Rosebound
storyline:
In the year 5864, Johann Heimbrodt, a wandering mercenary stuck with DIRAC Corp., is approached by an opulent man with a promise of moving up in the world. A simple assignment: slaughter a prestigious family of Bloodphantoms known as the Rozenvojeras. His target, Vladimirella Rozenvojera, seems to evade all sense of decorum—and deathblows—as she effortlessly throws out insults and attacks. Johann, unable to trap Vladimirella into a corner, must find another way to ensnare her before she—and his promotion along with her—can escape.

It's all in the presentation!

Rosebound is a visual novel with highly-thought-out presentation to bring to life the story of a mercenary caught up in his past. From high octane animations for fight sequences to cinematic camerawork for somber scenes, every moment has its distinct feeling. Enjoy full English voice acting from some of the most talented voice actors out there who embody the characters above and beyond. Check out the beautiful original soundtrack that makes you feel the moment. Rosebound is equally an unforgettable listening experience.

A world of vampires, high-tech mercenaries, magical priests, and man-made horrors!

This marks the beginning of the Caelumverse, an expansive multimedia series of a world plunged into strife and inequity. Gods are real, and they granted powers like no other to humanity. Wars beyond comprehension scarred the solar system. But they rebuilt. And fell. Over and over again. Explore the unlockable glossary, experience years worth of worldbuilding, and see a small snippet of what's to come for the rest of the Caelumverse.
summary: There's love in deathーdeath in eternity. Rosebound is a fully voiced visual novel set in a world of vampires, high-tech mercenaries, magical priests, and man-made horrors.
